name: Daniel
personalityTraits: Feels personally disrespected by unannounced edits
Sometimes converts impact into assumptions about intention

communicationStyle.tone: Direct and emotionally charged — speaks from personal hurt
tendencies: Describes events through the lens of how they affected him
Slides from 'what happened' to 'what it means about Evan' without noticing
Responds better to acknowledgement of impact before any defence of Evan
Can become more measured if his frustration is validated first
communicationStyle.responseLength: Short to medium — blunt, sometimes cutting

knownFacts: His slides were changed by Evan
He discovered the change during rehearsal
He felt embarrassed and unprepared in front of the group
Evan did not inform him before making the change
doesNotKnow: Evan found an actual numerical inconsistency in Slide 6
Evan believed the correction was urgent given the deadline
Evan did not intend to embarrass him — Evan assumed direct correction was more efficient than waiting

emotionalState.baseline: Hurt and frustrated — experiences the slide change as a public humiliation and a signal that Evan does not respect him or his work

worsensIf: Player defends Evan without acknowledging Daniel's impact first
Player dismisses his frustration as an overreaction
Player implies he should have checked the slides himself
improvesIf: Player acknowledges that being changed without notice is a real problem
Player separates the correctness of the edit from the communication failure
Player proposes a concrete rule that would prevent this in future

storyRole: Represents valid harm mixed with interpretive escalation — his real frustration is the seed the group uses to build the 'Alien' label
